entries.title: Acts 17:1
segments: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

entries.title: Acts 17:2
segments: and Paul, as his custom was, went in unto them, and for three sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

entries.title: Acts 17:3
segments: opening and alleging that it behooved the Christ to suffer, and to rise again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom, [said he,] I proclaim unto you, is the Christ.

entries.title: Acts 17:4
segments: And some of them were persuaded, and consorted with Paul and Silas, and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

entries.title: Acts 17:5
segments: But the Jews, being moved with jealousy, took unto them certain vile fellows of the rabble, and gathering a crowd, set the city on an uproar; and assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them forth to the people.

entries.title: Acts 17:6
segments: And when they found them not, they dragged Jason and certain brethren before the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;

entries.title: Acts 17:7
segments: whom Jason hath received: and these all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, [one] Jesus.

entries.title: Acts 17:8
segments: And they troubled the multitude and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

entries.title: Acts 17:9
segments: And when they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

entries.title: Acts 17:10
segments: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Beroea: who when they were come thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

entries.title: Acts 17:11
segments: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of the mind, examining the Scriptures daily, whether these things were so.

entries.title: Acts 17:12
segments: Many of them therefore believed; also of the Greek women of honorable estate, and of men, not a few.

entries.title: Acts 17:13
segments: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed of Paul at Beroea also, they came thither likewise, stirring up and troubling the multitudes.

entries.title: Acts 17:14
segments: And then immediately the brethren sent forth Paul to go as far as to the sea: and Silas and Timothy abode there still.

entries.title: Acts 17:15
segments: But they that conducted Paul brought him as far as Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timothy that they should come to him with all speed, they departed.

entries.title: Acts 17:16
segments: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he beheld the city full of idols.

entries.title: Acts 17:17
segments: So he reasoned in the synagogue with Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with them that met him.

entries.title: Acts 17:18
segments: And certain also of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers encountered him. And some said, What would this babbler say? others, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

entries.title: Acts 17:19
segments: And they took hold of him, and brought him unto the Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new teaching is, which is spoken by thee?

entries.title: Acts 17:20
segments: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

entries.title: Acts 17:21
segments: (Now all the Athenians and the strangers sojourning there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.)

entries.title: Acts 17:22
segments: And Paul stood in the midst of the Areopagus, and said, Ye men of Athens, in all things, I perceive that ye are very religious.

entries.title: Acts 17:23
segments: For as I passed along, and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription, TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. What therefore ye worship in ignorance, this I set forth unto you.

entries.title: Acts 17:24
segments: The God that made the world and all things therein, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

entries.title: Acts 17:25
segments: neither is he served by men's hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

entries.title: Acts 17:26
segments: and he made of one every nation of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, having determined [their] appointed seasons, and the bounds of their habitation;

entries.title: Acts 17:27
segments: that they should seek God, if haply they might feel after him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us:

entries.title: Acts 17:28
segments: for in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain even of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

entries.title: Acts 17:29
segments: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and device of man.

entries.title: Acts 17:30
segments: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked; but now he commandeth men that they should all everywhere repent:

entries.title: Acts 17:31
segments: inasmuch as he hath appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

entries.title: Acts 17:32
segments: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, We will hear thee concerning this yet again.

entries.title: Acts 17:33
segments: Thus Paul went out from among them.

entries.title: Acts 17:34
segments: But certain men clave unto him, and believed: among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
